description: The raw measurements behind the findings of an analysis: HTTP headers, redirect chain, SEO tags, axe-core violations with their DOM nodes, Core Web Vitals, WordPress fingerprint and page signals. Use it to verify a finding or to look deeper than the checks do. Null until the page has been crawled. Can be large.

crawlReport.description: Crawl report in the SiteIQ crawl_report 1.0.0 format, or null.
